# xperia-firmware-toolkit

> xperia-firmware-toolkit is a free, open-source Windows toolkit for pulling Sony Xperia stock firmware — from Xperia Companion or Sony's ESS distribution API — and rooting the Xperia 1 IV (XQ-CT72 / PDX223) with KernelSU Next.

## What it does
- Capture the firmware Xperia Companion downloads on Windows (partition .sin bundle).
- Download firmware without Companion via Sony's public ESS distribution API (HTTP Range).
- Reverse-engineering notes: Companion Java/OSGi internals, JRE-truststore MITM, SIN format.
- Root the Xperia 1 IV: extract stock boot.img, patch with KernelSU Next, fastboot flash boot, Zygisk + PIF + TrickyStore.
- adb data migration: contacts → vCard, SMS → restorable XML, media push, APK extraction.

## Install
```bash
git clone https://github.com/nsozturk/xperia-firmware-toolkit
```
Requires Windows, Android platform-tools (adb/fastboot); PowerShell + Python.

## Use
```bash
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File firmware-capture/watch_firmware_win.ps1
```
